notes.title: Street PvP Update
notes.notes:
Added Street PvP

 When you shoot a person and they shoot back at you, combat will start between you and the player you shot at.
 When you die you send half your money to the person who killed you
 Other players are now hidden in all Properties
 Removed 4th of July content


+ Other bug fixes and backend improvements
